headline: Crafting Table Tip
title: Aniimo Crafting Table Tip | Use Artisanship Workers | Aniimo Guide
video_script: Crafting in your Aniimo Homeland runs on workers, so pick the right ones. The Crafting Table uses the Artisanship ability, so assign an Aniimo with high Artisanship, not just any helper. Materials come from other facilities too. The Mine needs Earth workers, and the Well needs Water workers. Keep all three staffed and your crafting never stalls. What do you craft first? Comment below!
